song.name: Shadows in the Rain
song.plot: A melancholic moment between Anya and Seraphina before the final separation — the rain and shadows that bind them before Anya descends into the Void.
song.analysis: A melancholic moment between Anya and Seraphina before the final separation. Full structure restored (kept song); light anchors grafted: Seraphina's eyes, the vow.
